description: Vorranggebiet Deich is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Objective in the regional plan to keep the lined sites along rivers for the construction of dikes to prevent floods as superlocally effective measures. Origin:- Regional Planning Association Upper Lusatia/Lower Silesia with a legal basis Regional Plan, 1. Overall update (as of 04.02.2010), Regional Planning Association Oberes Elbtal/Osterzgebirge with legal basis Regional Plan, 1. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Priority area dyke" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Regionalplan, Vorranggebiet, Regionalplanerische Ausweisung, Ziel, Freiraum, VRG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
